extensionName.description: Extension name in the browser's extension list and store.

extensionDescription.message: Play videos from web pages in Light Media Center.
extensionDescription.description: Extension description in the browser's extension list and store.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button and heading of its popup.

controlRedirect.description: Button shown over a video that sends it to the application.

controlUnavailable.message: This video can't be sent to Light Media Center yet
controlUnavailable.description: Shown over a video whose kind cannot be sent in this version.

controlConnecting.description: Shown over a video while the extension connects to the application.

controlPlaying.description: Shown over the paused page video while it plays in the application.

controlReturn.description: Button that ends playback in the application and resumes the video in the page.

messageNotPaired.message: Pair this browser with Light Media Center first.

messagePairAction.description: Button that opens the pairing settings.

messageUnreachable.message: Light Media Center isn't reachable. Check that it is running and that browser connections are allowed in its settings.

messageUnauthorized.message: This video needs a sign-in that Light Media Center can't use.

messageUnsupported.message: Light Media Center can't play this video.

messageEncrypted.message: This video is protected and can't be played in Light Media Center.

messageError.message: Light Media Center stopped playing this video.

messageProtocol.message: This version of the extension doesn't match Light Media Center. Update both.

messageDisconnected.message: The connection to Light Media Center was lost.

statusConnected.description: Status line; $VERSION$ is the application version.

statusNotPaired.message: Light Media Center is running, but this browser isn't paired.

pairingStatePaired.message: This browser is paired with Light Media Center.

pairingStateNone.message: This browser isn't paired with Light Media Center.

pairingStateRevoked.message: Light Media Center no longer accepts this browser. Pair it again.

optionsForgetButton.description: Removes the pairing from this browser.

optionsPairingCode.message: Check that Light Media Center shows this code, then accept the request there.

optionsPairingRejected.message: Light Media Center declined the pairing, or the request timed out.

optionsForgetHint.message: To revoke access completely, also remove this browser from the paired browsers in Light Media Center's settings.

optionsPortHint.message: Use the port shown in Light Media Center's settings.

siteAccessMissing.message: The extension can't find videos until it's allowed to access websites.

popupNoVideos.message: No videos found on this page.

videoRedirect.description: Popup button that sends one video to the application.

videoLive.description: Marks a live stream in the popup video list.

controlArm.message: Reload and play in Light Media Center
controlArm.description: Button over a video that only the page itself can play; it reloads the page so the video can be sent to the application.

videoArm.description: Popup button that reloads the page so one of its videos can be sent to the application.

placeholderWaiting.message: Another video on this page is playing in Light Media Center.
placeholderWaiting.description: Shown over a video of the page while another video of the same page plays in the application.

placeholderClosed.message: This video was closed in Light Media Center.
placeholderClosed.description: Shown over a video after the application closed it.

placeholderReplaced.message: Another video is playing in Light Media Center now.
placeholderReplaced.description: Shown over a video after another video took its place in the application.

placeholderProtected.message: This video is protected. The page reloads to play it here.
placeholderProtected.description: Shown over a video that turned out to be protected, shortly before the page reloads and plays it in the browser.

popupArmed.message: Videos in this tab play in Light Media Center.
popupArmed.description: Popup notice for a tab whose videos are sent to the application.

popupDisarm.description: Popup button that stops sending this tab's videos to the application and reloads it.

startOffer.description: Shown over a video, or over a taken-over video's placeholder, when the application does not answer; a button next to it starts the application.

startAction.description: Button that opens the application through the browser, which may ask the user first.

startWaiting.message: Starting Light Media Center... If the browser asks whether to open it, allow it.
startWaiting.description: Shown with a progress bar while the extension waits for the application it asked the browser to open.

startNoAnswer.message: Light Media Center didn't answer on port $PORT$. If it opened, turn on "Allow browser connections" in its settings and check the port. If nothing opened, check that it is installed.
startNoAnswer.description: Shown when the application still does not answer after the wait. "Allow browser connections" is the name of the application's setting; $PORT$ is the port the extension connects to.

startTryAgain.description: Button that asks the browser to open the application again.

startOtherPort.message: Light Media Center answers on port $APP$, but the extension connects to port $EXTENSION$.
startOtherPort.description: $APP$ is the port the application answers on; $EXTENSION$ is the port set in the extension's options.

startUsePort.description: Button that sets the extension's port to the one the application answers on.
